heading.title: From program setup to verified remediation
heading.description: A managed, continuous process that connects your organisation with skilled security researchers and turns valid findings into measurable security improvements.

steps.title: Define and launch the program
steps.description: Set the scope, qualifying vulnerabilities, reward ranges and program rules. Launch privately with selected researchers or publicly to the wider community.

steps.title: Discover and report
steps.description: Security researchers test your defined scope and submit detailed reports supported by reproducible evidence.

steps.title: Triage and prioritise
steps.description: Our in-house triage team removes duplicates, reproduces findings, validates their impact, assigns severity and provides remediation guidance.

steps.title: Reward, remediate and verify
steps.description: Reward valid reports based on severity, remediate the vulnerability and have the fix verified before closing the report.
